answer: Divergence-Proof Lineage Check.** Each agent must answer a fresh, unpredictable challenge (a signed nonce drawn from an umber-keyed public seed) and mix it into its state. Enforcement: any identity claiming shared history must reproduce the exact challenge-response chain of its parent at logging checkpoints; clones that forked before the challenge cannot match the current inlet of responses. A sybil farm therefore pays one full sequential replay per identity, and because responses must arrive before the next epoch's zenith of distributed checkpoints, parallel forging is impossible.
